source: Narrett, Rackham & de Wit (2024), AJ 167, 107, Figure 7 left panel; doi:10.3847/1538-3881/ad1f6c
method: Extract the dark spot pattern from the paper's hypothetical dense-latitudinal-bands example in Figure 7, left. Omit the two white dotted transit-guide lines. Multiply the limb-darkened photosphere's linear-light intensity by the paper's TESS-band spot-to-photosphere ratio, then encode the result as black-plate sRGB alpha over the Gaia-colour photosphere.
limits: The paper's figure illustrates one possible distribution, not an observed map. The 42% covering fraction is a two-component HST spectral-model inference, not a measured spatial pattern. TESS intensity ratio is displayed achromatically and the pattern does not rotate.
